newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Illiquid Portuguese bonds end little changed.
newsitem.headline: Illiquid Portuguese bonds end little changed.

text.p: 1625 GMT - Bonds ended little changed in session where lack of liquidity principal feature. Longer end seen keeping step with lacklustre Bunds, traders said. *Sept 97 down six at 111.15 *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 102.70 vs 102.80. Yld 6.23 vs 6.22 *Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 68 bps vs 67 on Friday
